title: Mystic Beach Ritual
description: Two women sit on a large driftwood log on a beach at night. A blonde woman in a blue corset dress has her pregnant belly exposed while a dark-haired tattooed woman in a matching blue dress sits beside her, both surrounded by glowing candles and swirling blue magical energy under a cosmic starry sky with a luminous circular portal.
